# Private lexical root/CR linkage transaction

This extends the immutable `cache/lexical-probe` proof in a separate namespace.
It is not a registered editor feature. The executable uses a frozen54-image
fixture, actual sealed C35 classification, the unchanged released C29/R26
lexical producer/page service and actual R14 source/object/CRC instructions.
No host page reference is used by the final resolver.

```sh
python3 tests/test_cache_lexical_link.py --fixture build/cache-editor-product/20261026T045019460982Z/fixture
```

`--build-only` measures the actual linked profile. The new combined transaction
and resolver is4095 bytes including binding, real read-only arena OPEN, complete
page validator and source/capability guard. It has no new BSS, ZP, object or bank.
The released lexical capsules remain3993 and3917 bytes. Their original sources
are not modified. Source aliases and arena/lexer source copies come from the
frozen input; this script does not build canonical outputs.

## Deliberately narrow operation

Only an existing semantic baseline with a single complete CR page (1..42 records,
FIRST slot0, LAST slotCOUNT−1, same page/generation, NIL page adjacency) is
supported. A larger topology declines before writing. The link operation accepts
the fresh in-phase receipt returned by the actual released producer; this is an
exclusive owner4 caller protocol, not a persistent arbitrary-reference API.

Opcode0 starts LINK;1 advances;2 cancels;3 starts RESOLVE. Owner4 is checked before
frame access. Full caps3 is required; Plain/Markdown miss without frame writes.
The caller explicitly selects STEP after pending; no resident pump integration
is implied. On any carry-set result the caller must invoke CANCEL, which is
idempotent and releases only the epoch/token-matching source lease. A2 is a miss;
A3 is pressure/STREAM. Only complete A0 from RESOLVE authorizes returned refs.
Old output fields have no authority after a miss or error.

LINK acquires a fresh real counted R14 lease, compares all59 fields against the
actual producer snapshot, authenticates live arena/ticket/incarnation and source
graphs, then performs checked OPEN and full old CR-page CRC validation. It
captures the genuine C35 CR96 after source BEGIN into declared caller scratch
8200..825F. No canonical byte READ occurs during this metadata transaction; live
identity and graph guards run at each service boundary. The old matched CR must
equal all96 captured bytes before its lexical metadata is changed. START-only
matching and reconstructed parser state are not used.

The operation finds an actual allzero directory entry in the typed53 capacity.
It copies every old CR96 record to a new page, preserving order, inline refs and
every unrelated byte. The target changes only its explicit lexical-complete
flag, lexical ref/count and record CRC. Held records are CRC-checked again before
their write. Candidate page header/VALID and directory CRC/VALID are committed
separately, with one-byte VALID last. The new page is then reread through the
real complete-payload validator. Only afterwards is the alternate root written
INVALID and its single VALID byte published last. The selected old root and all
old referenced CR/INLINE/LEX pages remain unchanged.

Each STEP performs at most one metadata/payload transfer of128 bytes (record
transfers96); other steps perform bounded CPU checks/CRC or one existing OPEN/
page-reader step. The initial R14/overlay admission cost is separate. Frame576
and existing service scratch hold continuation. Root128 uses frame+259..386,
reader86 +173..258, old page header64 +94..157; the genuine CR snapshot uses
8200..825F until copying finishes. This scratch is not a new resident allocation.

## Explicit private schema

* Root FLAGS5 = BASE1 | LEX4: block/inline baseline complete, lexical capability
  available **per CR**. It does not claim every code line has lexical output.
  SPLICE's mapped flag2/rootFLAGS3 is distinct and is not accepted here. Future
  combinedFLAGS7 requires separate qualification; unknown combinations decline.
* Root lexical ABI1/epoch1 identifies this private `LXC1` descriptor96 + ordered
  span7 format. It is not an assertion that the proposed generic run8 format was
  implemented. Root block/inline ABI1 remain unchanged.
* CR bit10 hexadecimal is lexical-complete. Its ref47..50 is page/slot0/gen16;
  count51..53 is the actual producer span count. Other CRs retain NIL/zero and
  miss. ROOT FIRST/LAST are remapped to the copied CR page; count is unchanged.
* New root sequence increases exactly1; wrap refuses. New free page generation
  is1 because only allzero never-published directory entries are admitted.

RESOLVE starts from checked OPEN and the selected committed root, requiring
FLAGS5 and lexical ABI1. It matches the requested canonical CR START, validates
the CR page and record CRC/ticket, and obtains the lexical ref/count and BODY/END
from that CR. The actual released R26 consumer then validates the whole lexical
page and its full source/language/BODY/authority descriptor before roles become
READY. The test erases the original returned page receipt before RESOLVE.
Legacy ABI0/NIL roots safely miss. The original C35 correctly rejects FLAGS5/
lexABI1 rather than misinterpreting it as its supported ABI0 baseline.

## Executable scope and remaining integration

The narrow BASIC transaction copies five actual records, links one, resolves
through root/CR and matches independent roles via actual R26. Full16MiB checks
allow only the actual new CR page4096, directory8 and alternate root128. The old
selected root and every reachable page are exact. All13 precommit phases cancel
without publishing a new root; INVALID orphan staging may remain, never source
mutation. Guards cover foreign owners, policy bypass, ticket/incarnation and
source generation/revision faults, unavailable directory pressure and actual
multi-CR-page refusal. Existing canonical/history/catalog/shim assertions remain.

The probe replaces C5/eplay only because this narrow path never performs history
replay. Production uses eplay; it is **not free capacity**. An initial attempt to
replace C30/gfont failed because the real source renderer uses it; that failure
is retained. Neither substitution solves the cold catalogue, routing or lifecycle
budget. No asset was added to the frozen54-image import list. Production needs a
real coarse operation-sized placement, loader registration/headroom, supported
query profile and root/ref lifecycle before promotion.

Multi-page COW needs an authenticated replacement CR chain/index and root switch;
this profile does not change predecessor links or guess a sparse topology. Source
edits, W_LOAD representation changes, observer replay/rebase, lexical refresh,
faulted root recovery, source/preview consumer integration and native qualification
remain subsequent work. No global lexical completeness, end-to-end speedup or
goal-completion claim follows from this transaction proof.
